how_it_works.label: How It Works
how_it_works.headline: What Happens When You Contact Us

steps.title: You reach out.
steps.text: Call, or send a short note. Tell us the county and what you need: a letter you received, a tract to run, or a project to staff.

steps.title: We look at the record.
steps.text: We pull what the public record shows about your tract and your ownership.

steps.title: We report back in plain language.
steps.text: You get a clear picture of what you own, what the document says, and where the risk sits.

steps.title: You decide the next step, with us.
steps.text: If a question needs an attorney, we will tell you, and we are glad to work alongside yours.
